records.label: current
records.learner: Auntie, I'll keep the salary number to myself, but I'm doing fine out there. How about you? How's my cousin this year?

disclosures.quote: he's, uh… taking a break at home for now

npc.text: Ha! ‘Doing fine,’ what's there to hide from your own auntie? Your cousin? Oh, he's, uh… taking a break at home for now. Anyway, you skipped my other question. When's this someone coming home, hm?

records.label: current
records.learner: 大姨，工资这个我就不在饭桌上报数啦，够我自己在那边过得挺好。倒是您最近怎么样？表哥今年忙不忙？

npc.text: 哟，还不在饭桌上报，跟大姨还保密呢？你表哥啊……他今年……在家歇一阵，不急。哎，别光说他，对象呢？工资不说，对象总能说吧？
吃菜吃菜，你大姨也是关心你。

records.label: current
records.learner: I know you ask because you care. If there's ever someone serious, you'll be the first to meet them. Not yet, though.

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: Auntie, I'll keep the salary number to myself, but I'm doing fine out there.
If there's ever someone serious, you'll be the first to meet them. Not yet, though.

npc.text: ‘Not yet'? But your mum told me soon! At twenty-nine, other people's kids already have a little one running around. So which is it?
Aiya, eat while it's hot. Here, have some fish. Your aunt just cares about you, that's all.

records.label: current
records.learner: 我知道您是关心我。对象的事我自己有数，真有了一定第一个带回来，现在还没到那一步。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 对象的事我自己有数，真有了一定第一个带回来，现在还没到那一步。

npc.text: 还没到那一步？那你妈怎么跟我说快了呀？哎你也二十九了，人家好些跟你一般大的，孩子都上幼儿园了，你可得抓点紧。
哎呀，孩子大了，心里有主意……来，尝尝这个鱼，今天烧得入味。

records.label: current
records.learner: If I earned enough to pay for this whole dinner, I'd announce it, promise.

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: Auntie, I'll keep the salary number to myself, but I'm doing fine out there.
If I earned enough to pay for this whole dinner, I'd announce it, promise.

npc.text: Ha! Pay for this whole table? Then you'd better get working, it'll take a while! Fine, fine, keep your little secret. So what do you actually do all day out there? Your mum never explains it properly.
I explain it, you just don't listen. Go on, tell her, and have some fish while you're at it.

records.label: current
records.learner: 要是我工资高到能请全家吃这顿饭，我肯定主动报，哈哈。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 对象的事我自己有数，真有了一定第一个带回来，现在还没到那一步。

npc.text: 哈哈，这孩子，嘴倒是越来越贫了！行行行，不说就不说，大姨还能扒你工资条啊。那你在那边到底干的啥活儿？天天加班不？过年能在家待几天？
就是，难得回来一趟，跟你大姨说说那边的事。

records.label: current
records.learner: Mum, what made you tell Auntie it'd be soon? I'm not upset, I just want us to say the same thing.

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: Auntie, I'll keep the salary number to myself, but I'm doing fine out there.
If I earned enough to pay for this whole dinner, I'd announce it, promise.

disclosures.quote: I only said ‘soon’ so she'd stop asking. I'm not in any hurry, you know that.

npc.text: Aiya… honestly? Your aunt kept bringing it up, so I only said ‘soon’ so she'd stop asking. I'm not in any hurry, you know that.
Hah! So my own sister's been fobbing me off! Fine, fine, ‘not yet’ it is. But you still haven't told me what you actually do all day out there.

records.label: current
records.learner: 妈，你跟大姨说「快了」，是怎么回事呀？我不怪你，就想知道咱俩以后对外怎么说。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 对象的事我自己有数，真有了一定第一个带回来，现在还没到那一步。

disclosures.quote: 我那是被你大姨问烦了，随口应付一句

npc.text: 哎……我那是被你大姨问烦了，随口应付一句，哪有什么快不快的。我也没急着让你结婚，这事儿……咱回头再说，啊？
好哇，合着你们娘俩糊弄我呢！行，那大姨不管了。刚问你的还没答呢，在那边到底干啥的，过年能待几天？

records.label: current
records.learner: 刚才我语气可能有点冲，大姨别往心里去。年后我们再好好聊聊，我也想听听表哥那边的情况。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 对象的事我自己有数，真有了一定第一个带回来，现在还没到那一步。
年后我们再好好聊聊，我也想听听表哥那边的情况。

npc.text: 冲啥呀，大姨没那么小气。行，年后就年后……你表哥那边也没啥好聊的，就是歇着。倒是你，刚问你的还没说呢，这回能在家待几天？
对对，跟你大姨说说，她念叨你好几回了。
